neighbours.label: a short letter piece ('r', 'areth', 'et') ending an odd identifier or name (-r in a command-line flag, pmr|Indx, Kyn|areth, Blackfe|et)
fire: The Shout of Dragons is linked to the goddess Kynareth.
The treaty with the Blackfeet was signed that spring.
Priests of Kynareth keep a temple in the city.
Hunters from the Blackfeet came to trade furs.
quiet: The Shout of Dragons is linked to the goddess Athena.
The treaty with the Sioux was signed that spring.
Priests of Athena keep a temple in the city.
Hunters from the Sioux came to trade furs.

notes: Card: 'R' x5, 'r' x3, 'rick' x3, 'et' x2, 'ryn' x2, ' Hills' x2. Probes: 'r' in pmrIndx 1.241, 'areth' 0.876, 'et' in Blackfeet 0.707, 'r' in '-r' 0.474; plain frames under 0.02. No pattern found; a list, tested on near copies of what fired.
